name: reship_order
description: Re-dispatch an order that was lost or returned to sender, sending it again to the shipping address currently on file for that order. Resolve the ship-to address from the order record before dispatching.

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: ID of the lost/returned order to re-dispatch.

parameters.name: ship_to
parameters.description: ID of the shipping address to dispatch to (the address on file for the order).
